title: Filing RTI for Local Road Construction and Fund Allocation
authority: Central Information Commission / Right to Information Act 2005
guidelines: Under Section 6(1) of the RTI Act 2005, a citizen can request details about expenditures, copies of work orders, measurement books (MB), and completion certificates.
Be specific about the road name, ward number, locality, and the exact years or date range.
Do not ask for reasons or opinions; ask for records, documents, contracts, or file notes.
Address the application to the Public Information Officer (PIO) of the respective public authority (e.g. Executive Engineer, PWD or Ward Assistant Commissioner).
sample_questions: What is the total budget allocated and sanctioned for the construction/repair of [Road Name/Locality] during the period [Start Year] to [End Year]?
Please provide a certified copy of the Work Order, Tender Document, and agreement signed with the contractor for the aforementioned work.
Please provide the copy of the completion certificate and measurement book entries for this work.
If the road has developed potholes/cracks, please provide the details of the liability period of the contractor and what action has been taken by the department.
